name: Construct the diagram
note: Method step 3. A decomposed subsystem of forces arrives as data; the designer cell emits a constructive diagram — a small organism manifest — and spawn admits and runs it immediately. Alexander's pattern is both the summary of the forces and the recipe for the form; here that is literal, because the emitted diagram executes. If the spawned child misfits (bad manifest, contract violation), the failure arrives on a declared edge as a misfit record — the diagram step is itself inside declared-failure-path.

cells.prompt: Emit ONE algal.organism.v1 manifest — a constructive diagram resolving this small system of forces. Keep it minimal and input-free: a const cell emitting the resolution text, interface.outputs {out}. The manifest is data; it will be admitted, spawned, and run now.
